text: Using supernumerary multi-limbs for complex tasks is a growing research focus in Virtual Reality (VR) and robotics. Understanding how users integrate extra limbs to achieve shared goals is crucial for developing efficient supernumeraries. This paper presents an exploratory study (N=14) investigating strategies for controlling virtual supernumerary limbs with varying autonomy in VR object manipulation tasks. Using a Wizard-of-Oz approach to simulate semi-autonomous limbs, we collected qualitative and quantitative data.
